en: Vintage black‑and‑white streetscape showing a grand historicist building with ornate façade, clock and roof decorations on the left, likely a civic or railway-related structure. A broad tree‑lined street extends into the distance with people walking, a cyclist, and a horse‑drawn wagon. The scene has an early 20th‑century European atmosphere. At the top in red Gothic-style script is the caption "Großenhain Bahnhofstraße".
